symbols.name: layout permutation
symbols.meaning: The explicit permutation of record addresses that places the selected bits in the required chunks.
symbols.quote: Transform layout is an explicit permutation $L$ of record addresses, which preserves each record's polynomial suffix.

symbols.name: log record length
symbols.meaning: The base-two logarithm of $r$, which is the number of address bits in a long axis.
symbols.quote: Here $\ell$ is the base-two logarithm of $r$, so a long axis has $\ell$ address bits and a short axis has $\ell-1$.

relations.quote: The layout is built from [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) moves of whole chunks, together with single-bit moves.
The layout prepares the input for each [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) of a transform round.

relations.predicate: is applied within each round of
relations.quote: The layout is applied within each round of the [synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md).
The layout feeds its retained order to the [opposite transform](opposite-transform.md), which consumes that order.
